instructions.purpose: Change one of the user's own connectors: its description, or whether the app's plain chats may use it. For a new URL, remove the connector and add the new one.

tool.name: update-connector
tool.description: Takes id and at least one of description (one line saying when to use the server) and plainChats (true lets the app's plain chats use it). Returns id, description, plainChats and status after the change.

usage_rules.rule: Call list-connectors first and use an id it returned
Give only the fields the user wants changed
If the tool reports a missing connector, nothing was changed: call list-connectors again

example.context: User says: "let my plain chats use the notes server" (list-connectors returned notes)
